# usejinai.com

> usejinai.com handles sales for Jin AI and is operated by Jin AI. Jin AI is an AI assistant for teams. It spots repetitive work in the email, calendar, chat, and files a team connects, prepares drafts such as meeting briefs, status updates, and replies, and learns from each approval, edit, or skip. It never sends anything without a person's approval. Customer data is not used to train AI models. The official site is https://jinai.md/.

## Pages

- [Use Jin AI | Guides for Teams Using a Proactive AI Assistant](https://usejinai.com/): Practical guides for using an AI assistant that prepares repetitive work: meeting prep, weekly updates, follow-ups, and admin controls, organized by role and task.
- [How to Use an AI Assistant That Prepares Work Before You Ask | usejinai](https://usejinai.com/guides/proactive-ai-assistant/): What a proactive AI assistant is, how to start in four steps, examples by role, and answers to common questions. A practical guide from the Jin AI team.
- [All guides](https://usejinai.com/guides/): Index by role, task, and for admins
- [How to Stop Preparing for Meetings by Hand](https://usejinai.com/guides/meeting-prep/): Briefs and agendas built from the conversations that led up to the meeting.
- [How to Write the Weekly Status Update Without the Scramble](https://usejinai.com/guides/weekly-status-update/): Start from a draft of what moved this week, not a blank page.
- [Follow-Ups That Don't Slip: Customers and Candidates](https://usejinai.com/guides/follow-ups/): Replies drafted after calls and when a customer or candidate is still waiting.
- [What an AI Assistant Should and Should Not Read](https://usejinai.com/guides/what-an-ai-assistant-should-read/): How admins choose what Jin can use, and what it never does.
- [Why Your Team Uses AI Tools but Still Does the Work](https://usejinai.com/guides/why-teams-still-do-the-work/): Most AI tools wait for a request. The prep work stays with people.

## Key facts

- Works with: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Slack, Microsoft Teams
- Output: drafts for review (briefs, agendas, updates, replies)
- Admin controls: choose teams and tools; exclude folders, channels, labels, or teams
- Privacy: findings go to the employee, not their manager; no scoring or ranking of people; each company's data kept separate
- How to start: one team and one repetitive task (pilot)
- Demo and contact: https://jinai.md/ (hello@jinai.md)
